title: 彭博有限合伙企业：伊朗石油退出，油价为何涨不动？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Steven from the market perspective, how does the end of Iran's oil wave change the outlook?
segments.zh: 从市场角度看，伊朗石油浪潮的结束如何改变前景？

segments.en: had replaced their flows from the Persian Gulf. And so you were seeing this sort of flood of Iranian vessels coming in. It was kind of pushing prices down further. And with the
segments.zh: 替换了来自波斯湾的供应。大量伊朗油轮涌入，进一步压低了价格。随着
